correctness.rationale: Read full RESULT.md proof, underlying Erickson-Kretschmann facets and exact rational source verifier. There are 2q coordinate and q-1 comparison facets, normals in sum-one hyperplane as specified. All FF/FG pairs are ridges; GG cross-row iff first-row zero column i<=second-row zero column k, with i>k forcing four zero coordinates, hence codim>=4. Same-row GG all ridges. Pair counts are q-2 adjacent FF, (q-2)(q-3)/2 disjoint FF, FG signed 2(q-1) each and orthogonal 2(q-1)(q-2), GG (3q^2-q)/2, summing (2q-1)^2. Gram products produce beta, pi/3, alpha, right, pi-beta. The exact mean cancels opposite beta classes, leaving -(q-2)pi/(6(2q-1)^2) and -((3q²-q)/2)asin(1/(2q-1))/(2q-1)^2. At scale q rare pi/3 ridges cause -pi/24 discrepancy despite vanishing probability; an explicit nonuniform integrability phenomenon. Independent numeric recomputation through q=10000 and inspected rational rank verifier for q=2..7 corroborate finite cases, not all-q proof.
